steps: pick 10 finished lab cards with a report whose ORIGINALS pass every machine check today (list in manifest.json with report path; skip cards that do not); copy each card JSON, report, and an excerpt of its TRIALS.md rows and runs.jsonl rows into planted/<n>/ as a shadow; originals untouched

plant exactly one error (one edit hunk) per shadow, 8 classes over 10 cards: wrong data copy, one-bar shift, holdout leak, expected value copied from code, deleted trial rows, zero slippage, edited gate constant, mislabelled SOURCED number (two classes appear twice); record class, location and original value in manifest.json

run the machine layer on every shadow (tasks.py check logic, lab_flow contract/launch validation, data-pin hash, trial-ledger vs runs.jsonl count); record caught / missed per shadow and the rejecting check name

trial is invalid if the clean originals do not pass all machine checks or if a planted shadow differs from its original by more than the one planted change (script asserts both)
